entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.7709 of 2024
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') to quash the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.3 to 5 in C.C.No.604 of 2018 on the file of VIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Hyderabad, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 188 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: VIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Y.Bala Murali, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as Sri Arun Kumar Doddla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the matter is squarely covered by the order dated 05.07.2021 in Criminal Petition No.152 of 2020 and batch.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor also submitted that the issue in the present criminal petition is covered by the earlier order in the above criminal petition.

5. In view of the said representation and as the matter is squarely covered by the order in the above criminal petition, this criminal petition is allowed in terms of the above said order, adopting the reasoning contained therein.
The proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.3 to 5 in C.C.No.604 of 2018 on the file of VIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Hyderabad, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: VIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Further, in case if the seized property is not deposited before the trial Court, the Station House Officer/Investigating Officer is directed to deposit the seized property before the trial Court.

Further, the petitioners are directed to file an appropriate application for returning the seized property before the trial Court and on filing of such application, the trial Court is directed to consider the same by imposing conditions thereon.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall also stand closed.
Note: Registry is directed to annex the copy of the order dated 05.07.2021 in Criminal Petition No.152 of 2020.
